newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea 3-yr yields end lower on brisk buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea 3-yr yields end lower on brisk buying.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporate bonds closed lower on Monday due to revived buying interest from institutions and an expectation of possible intervention by the government, brokers said.
Three-month CD yields and overnight call fell thanks to an improvement in short-term liquidity.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.62 pct from Saturday's 12.70
* Overnight call average at 12.8 pct from 13.5
